newsitem.title: MEXICO: Femsa says Philip Morris sells stake in company.
newsitem.headline: Femsa says Philip Morris sells stake in company.

text.p: Mexican beverage company Fomento Economico Mexicano SA (Femsa) said on Friday that U.S. conglomerate Philip Morris Cos Inc had sold its 7.92 percent stake in the Mexican company.
In a statement, Femsa said the operation took place through the sale of 42.9 million shares in the Monterrey-based beverage company in recent weeks.
The statement did not say the price at which the shares had been sold or who had bought them.
Femsa is the anchor bottler for Coca-Cola in Mexico and also is Mexico's second biggest brewer, producing well-known beers such as Sol, Tecate, Dos Equis and Bohemia.
